steps.action: Build Volatility Charges by staying close to Bahamet.
Build the required 3 Volatility Charges.
Bait the appropriate Special to trigger Radiation.
Radiation creates the important projectile.
Interact with the Radiation Blast to obtain a Removal Charge.
Knock Bahamet down while you have the Removal Charge.
Corrupted Armor is removed.
Use your strongest attacks during the vulnerability window.
Stay close and build the required Volatility.
Bait the appropriate Special and trigger Radiation.
Perform the Radiation Blast interaction.
Prepare to reflect the Blast back toward Bahamet.
Use a Heavy Attack or Well-Timed Block interaction to reflect it.
The reflected Radiation Blast interacts with Bahamet.
Corrupted Armor is removed.
Take advantage of the damage window.
Stay close and build Volatility again.
Bait the required Special.
Wait for the projectile.
Watch carefully — the Radiation Blast can be replaced by a Fire Blast.
Perform the normal reflection/interaction.
Do NOT try to reflect it. Avoid/block it appropriately.
Successfully complete the Radiation mechanic to remove the Armor.
Use your big attacks while Bahamet is vulnerable.
Removal Charges are no longer required.
Build Volatility and trigger Radiation.
Prepare to reflect the Blast.
Successful reflection removes 20% of his Damage Reduction.
A successful Well-Timed Block reflection removes 25% of his Damage Reduction.
Continue reflecting Radiation Blasts.
Once the Damage Reduction reaches 0%, Corrupted Armor loses its protective function.
Finish Bahamet before he can reach SP3.

steps.action: Use the Spirit/Relic interaction to damage Spirit Armor.
Knock Cerastes down → 100 Armor stacks damaged.
Hit into his Block → 100 Shield stacks damaged.
Once one Armor is damaged, it locks. Damage a different Armor.
Reduce an Armor variant to 0 stacks.
That Armor loses its 30% damage reduction for 12s.
Break the other Armor variants and refresh the active Break timers.
Cerastes becomes Passively Stunned for 16s.
Dump your strongest attacks during the Stun.
Leg, Shield and Spirit all begin at 225 stacks.
Use the correct action for the active Armor.
Once damaged, that Armor locks.
Damage another Armor type.
Trying to damage a locked Armor causes Cerastes to immediately repair 100 stacks on that Armor.
Bring an Armor variant to 0.
Gain the +125% damage window.
Break all three → 16s Passive Stun.
Use your biggest damage during the Stun.
Leg/Shield/Spirit start with random stacks between 50–250.
Damage one Armor → it locks.
Damage another Armor.
Cerastes can no longer be Stunned by normal Stun effects.
Trying to damage a locked Armor triggers its Overcharge. ☠️
Bring Armor to 0 to break it.
Cerastes takes +125% damage.
All three broken → 16s Passive Stun.
Go hard during the damage window.
All three Armor systems become permanently Overcharged.
Cerastes loses 4% Max Health over 16s.
While all systems are Overcharged, Cerastes takes NO damage from you.
Let his own Overcharge drain his Health.
His suit enters Meltdown.
Overcharges deactivate and his Health stops draining.
Both Champions' Attack Ratings become 0.
Cerastes gains an indefinite Intimidate Passive.
Strike Cerastes' Block with a Light Attack.
This deals 99,999 Direct Damage and finishes him.

steps.action: Build the Divine Punishments through their specific actions.
Every activated Punishment gives +40% Prowess.
Bait and punish Glykhan's Heavy or Special.
Your combo following the punish can now deal damage.
Fully dex his Special to remove 1 random Punishment.
All Punishments are removed and you gain 3 extra Prowess.
Continue punishing Heavy/SP → combo → damage.
Glykhan decides randomly between SP1 and SP2.
You won't know which one until he activates it.
Glykhan gains an Unstoppable Passive.
Glykhan gains an Unblockable Passive.
Each Special hit you make him miss/avoid reduces the duration of his Passive.
After successfully avoiding it, punish the Special and continue your combo.
After his Special, Glykhan rapidly regains Power up to 2 Bars.
Keep the fight moving and avoid allowing him to reach SP3.
All Divine Punishments begin at maximum stacks.
Instead of adding stacks, triggering one removes it while still giving Prowess.
Work through the Punishments until all are removed.
After all are removed, they can be reapplied after the next damaging combo chain.
When Glykhan charges Heavy or activates Special while you're in striking distance, you become Rooted briefly.
You must work around the Root while punishing Heavy/SP.
Once per fight, a lethal hit can trigger 16s Indestructible.
During Indestructible, Glykhan's landed attacks instantly KO you.
Once Indestructible ends, continue the punishment → combo → damage cycle.
SURVIVE — don't get hit
Punish → Combo → FINISH
